messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call discovery: success hypothesis, gating criteria, and sprint calendar

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum while your infra team validates the networking requirements: 

High-level success hypothesis (what a successful 30-day POC demonstrates):
- System can serve 95th percentile generation latency <= 400ms for target 1k concurrent users (simulated load).
- Average per-token cost stays within your budget envelope (guide: <= $0.015/token for baseline prompts).
- No data leakage to third-party services; logs retained per FinRise retention policy.
- End-to-end integration with your API (auth + routing) and one internal workflow demonstrates quality > 85% on your eval set.

Proposed POC cadence and owners:
- Kickoff (week 0): Redwood + FinRise alignment, infra checklist (deadline: Nov 17). Owners: Kimberly (Redwood), Tom (FinRise infra).
- Week 1: Baseline integration + sample evals. Owners: Rishi (Redwood SE), FinRise API lead.
- Week 2: Load experiments + cost tuning; quick quantization test if needed. Owners: Priyom (Redwood), FinRise SRE.
- Week 3: Acceptance run + readout prep. Owners: Marissa (Redwood CS), FinRise PM.
- Final readout: Nov 30 — demo results + decision gating.

Gating criteria (pass/fail to move to readout):
1) Integration: API calls authenticated and routed (smoke tests pass).
2) Performance: 95th latency target met OR documented mitigation plan with fallbacks.
3) Quality: Evaluation metrics on the shared prompt set >= 85% (or agreed delta vs baseline).

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC success hypothesis and a short networking checklist your infra team asked for. Also dropped a MAP draft in the Drive link below for tracking tasks.

Immediate asks from FinRise: please confirm the API test endpoint, a contact for SRE (for firewall rules), and whether you have an internal eval set we can use (or if we should start with a synthetic seed).

If this looks good I’ll block the kickoff for Mon Nov 22 (calendar link below). If Nov 22 is tight we can slide to the following week.

Calendar / Drive: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-kickoff | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-finrise

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Post-call discovery: success hypothesis, gating criteria, and sprint calendar

Thanks, Kimberly — this is very helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick items from our side: 

- FinRise can provide an eval set (10k anonymized prompts). I’ll have the PM share a sanitized sample by Friday (Nov 13).
- Our SRE contact for firewall/VPC peering is Priya N. (cc’ing her on a separate thread). For now, Tom will be the point for scheduling connectivity windows.
- Can we move the final readout to Dec 1 instead of Nov 30? That gives us a full business week to validate integration and not rush acceptance.

Two questions for the POC plan: 
1) Data retention & audit: Do you have a standard SOC2 evidence packet for data handling during trials? We’ll need that for procurement.
2) If we hit a performance regression during load tests, do you have a recommended mitigation sequence (fallback to smaller model / reduce concurrency / temporary queueing)?

Assuming answers to the above, we’re happy to proceed — please go ahead and schedule kickoff for Mon Nov 22 and we’ll confirm internal attendees.

Best,
Susan Lee
Head of Product, FinRise
Susan.Lee@finrise.com

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call discovery: success hypothesis, gating criteria, and sprint calendar

Nice summary, Kim. Quick technical notes to surface before kickoff so Tom’s team can prepare: 

- SOC2 / compliance: we have a standard trial evidence packet (SOC2 controls mapping, data flow diagram, log retention statements). I attached the packet and will drop the SOC2 summary into the Drive folder.
- Mitigation sequence for regressions (recommended order):
  1) Reduce concurrent streamers (soft cap) + enable batching windows (minimal perf impact).
  2) Fallback to a lower-cost variant (we maintain compatible model variants) while preserving prompt schema.
  3) Temporary rate-limiter with queued retries and a defined SLA for replays.

- Infra checklist items needed from FinRise before we run load: API test endpoint, bearer token for test account (scoped), NAT/firewall rules, and estimated concurrency profile (typical and peak).

I’ve attached a short runbook snippet (networking-checklist.xlsx) and the SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf. I’ll be on the kickoff and will lead the Week 1 integration work.

-Rishi
